# F004: Check the pruning logic for single-block SOFT packets
print("=== F004: Single-block SOFT pruning ===")
packet = composer.DirectivePacket(
    layer="domain", name="test", text="A" * 100,
    constraint_class="SOFT"
)
print(f"Original text length: {len(packet.text)}")
pruned = composer._prune_packet_directives(packet, 10)
print(f"Pruned text length: {len(pruned.text)}")
print(f"Pruned text: '{pruned.text[:80]}...'")
# The block is SOFT, it gets removed from retained, pruned_text becomes ""
# and then the final line: return replace(packet, text=pruned_text if pruned_text else packet.text)
# So if pruned_text is empty, it returns the ORIGINAL text!
# This means _prune_packet_directives is a NO-OP for single-block SOFT packets!

print("\n=== F006: CID sensitivity ===")

packets = [
    composer.DirectivePacket(layer="u", name="core", text="A"*100, constraint_class="HARD"),
    composer.DirectivePacket(layer="s", name="sit", text="B"*50, constraint_class="SOFT"),
]

    composer.DirectivePacket(layer="u", name="core", text="A"*100, constraint_class="HARD"),
    composer.DirectivePacket(layer="s", name="sit", text="C"*50, constraint_class="SOFT"),
]
cid2 = composer._compute_cid(packets2, "deepseek_v3")
print(f"CID with (100, 50) chars but different text: {cid2}")

# situation directives with same length produce the same CID. That's a collision.
